title: The Demon's Scribe
description: A woman in a pink Victorian dress sits at a teal desk writing in a book with a quill. She holds a glowing blue anatomical heart connected by red tubes to a large demonic mechanical eye displayed on a screen above the desk, which is labeled 'DEMON'. A bowl containing a red rose with dripping liquid sits beside her.
prompt: A woman with dark hair in an updo wearing a pink patterned Victorian dress with green skirt sits at an ornate teal wooden desk writing with a quill in a book. She holds a glowing blue anatomical heart in her left hand connected by red tubes to a giant mechanical demonic eye with gears and robotic elements displayed on a large ornate screen labeled DEMON. A blue bowl with a vibrant red rose dripping red liquid sits on the desk. The background wall is purple with framed anatomical heart and rose illustrations. Surreal symbolic style with rich details and dramatic lighting.
